name: Quotation Landing Page Navigation
description: Verify basic page navigation on the landing header.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the home page at https://quotat.netlify.app/
Click on the About us link in the header
Verify that the About Us page content renders and the URL contains /about
Click on the Contact Us link in the header
Verify that the Contact Us page renders and the URL contains /contact

name: Quotation Form Calculation and Preview Redirect
description: Verify the Quotation calculator computes GST, grand total, and redirects to preview correctly.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the quotation builder at https://quotat.netlify.app/quotation
Type QT-8899 in the input for Quotation No
Type Consulting Company in the Your Business Name input field under Your Details
Type Client Industries in the Clients Business Name input field under Client Details
Type Development Service in the first row item description input
Type 2 in the first row item quantity input
Type 1500 in the first row item rate input
Click on the Add GST button
Select GST mode and specify tax percentage 18 in the GST settings overlay
Click the Apply button in the GST settings overlay
Verify the subtotal displays 3000, the GST amount displays 540, the grand total displays 3540, and the total in words reads Three Thousand Five Hundred Forty Rupees Only
Click the Save and Continue button
Verify the page redirects to the quotation preview screen at /preview

name: Quotation Preview Authentication Guard
description: Verify that clicking finalize or print redirects an unauthenticated user to login.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the preview page at https://quotat.netlify.app/preview
Verify the screen states no quotation data found
Navigate to the quotation builder page at https://quotat.netlify.app/quotation
Type QT-1212 in the Quotation No input field
Click the Save and Continue button
Click the Finalize and Download or Save and Print button on the preview page
Verify the page redirects to the user Login screen at /login
Type non_existent@techtimes.com in the login email field
Type wrong_password in the login password field
Click the Login button
Verify that an authentication error message is displayed to the user

name: Successful Login and Dashboard Navigation
description: Verify that a user can successfully login with correct credentials and see the dashboard.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the user login page at https://quotat.netlify.app/login
Type raz@gmail.com in the login email field
Type Test@12345 in the login password field
Click the Login button
Verify that the page redirects to /dashboard and the Welcome to Techtimes message is visible on the dashboard
